# The cases of the corpus of env (compare/env/corpus.py); the format: host/recon/casefile.py. src = src/cmd/env.c.

== print
# src: without a command: the environment, one per line
-- case
step: env

== print-env
-- case
env: FOO=bar
env: ZED=1
step: env

== clear
# src: "-": an empty environment
-- case
env: FOO=bar
step: env -

== add
# src: NAME=VALUE is added
-- case
step: env - A=1 B=2

== replace
# src: the same name: the later value
-- case
env: FOO=bar
step: env FOO=new

== replace-twice
-- case
step: env - A=1 A=2 B=3 A=4

== empty-value
-- case
step: env - A= B=x

== command
# src: a command runs with the new environment
-- case
step: env - X=1 /bin/env

== command-path
# src: execvp searches PATH
-- case
step: env - PATH=/bin X=y env

== command-args
-- case
step: env - /bin/echo a b c

== not-found
# src: "%s: %s\n" of sys_errlist[errno] and the name, exit 1
-- case
step: env nosuchcommand

== not-found-path
-- case
step: env - PATH=/nonexist nosuchcommand

== not-executable
-- f
data
-- case
step: env ./f

== script
# execvp runs a file without a magic number with the shell
-- s
echo from script
-- case
host: chmod 755 s
step: env ./s

== dash-later
# src: "-" only as the first argument
-- case
step: env A=1 -
